Game Overview

Flappy Bird Classic is a animal title where guide a determined bird through an endless obstacle course in Flappy Bird Classic. Simple yet addictive, each flap challenges your patience and timing. Beat your personal best as you soar through randomly generated pipes, mastering the rhythm to stay aloft. Test your persistence in this classic arcade pursuit.
